SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(g.price), 2), 0) AS avgPrice, COUNT(g.goods_id) AS goodsCount FROM category c LEFT JOIN goods g ON c.category_id = g.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY avgPrice DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN price < 50 THEN '0-50元' WHEN price < 100 THEN '50-100元' WHEN price < 200 THEN '100-200元' WHEN price < 500 THEN '200-500元' ELSE '500元以上' END AS priceRange, COUNT(*) AS goodsCount FROM goods GROUP BY priceRange ORDER BY MIN(price)
